The Cavaliers (5-5, 1-3 on the road) are 2nd in the Central, 1.5 games back and 7th in the East, and this is their 11th game of the 2026-27 season. The Hornets (3-7) have lost six straight, sit 4th in the Southeast and 3.5 games back, and are 10th in the East. The teams have not met yet this season, but Cleveland won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 118-113 win in Charlotte on February 20.

Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow), and Jarrett Allen (knee) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Charlotte is missing Brandon Miller (groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (hamstring strain), Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), while Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) is day-to-day.
